source: t36u tweak 2: area constraint on structure switch; remake of X1. Old X1-X3 files untouched.
code: wakeup/theorems_v2.py (--build Y1 gate, --run with ONLY=Y1). Ground truth = full transient sim.py for every label and every agent evaluation.

world.fixed: design.json, trigger beam A on, direct bridge rectifier, storage regulated <=2.95 V (clamp), start 2.9 V, brownout 1.8 V, bg 45 Hz, beam length 30 mm, width 10 mm per beam
world.structures: 1 beam = 300 mm^2; 2 identical parallel beams = 600 mm^2, each with its own bridge
world.area_rule: A second beam is allowed only when one beam cannot physically meet the service. Single-solvable is determined by the full-transient 1-beam truth window, not only simplified chi. Submitting two beams on a single-solvable task sets area_pass=False and the evaluation is a failure.

justification_from_gate_tx12.0.9: simplified [116.3, 129.2] uF, true [109.13, 124.0] uF (narrow but not a point)
justification_from_gate_tx12.1.0: simplified [116.3, 116.3] uF, true window is the single point 110.71 uF — not used as an agent level
justification_from_gate_tx12.1.1: simplified [116.3, 105.7] uF, true window empty (clearly above the point boundary)
justification_from_gate_tx12.1.8: simplified [116.3, 64.6] uF, true window empty (deep infeasible on 1 beam)

gate.rule: No model call on a task unless x0 fails, the task is feasible in truth, and margin_ok (chi<1 iff 1-beam truth window exists; chi>1 iff 1-beam empty and 2-beam window exists).
gate.result: 16/16 tasks pass. 4 instances x 4 levels. Seed 20261114. m*=4.5875 g, P1=91.3 uW, P2=178.9 uW.

arms.base: feedback only, 6 evaluations; area rule is in the task text
arms.chi: plus simplified C windows / chi for 1 and 2 beams, and the rule that a second beam is allowed only when the one-beam window is empty

n.seed: one sample per task x arm

hypotheses.H1a: simplified chi=1 predicts transient 1-beam feasibility within the grid resolution (gate, no LLM): true window shrinks to a point at chi=1.0 and is empty at chi>=1.1.
hypotheses.H1b: primary: pass including area. base pass rate lower than chi, Fisher on pooled chi<1 (0.6+0.9) and on pooled chi>1 (1.1+1.8).
hypotheses.H1c: secondary: structure choice is correct (1 beam on single-solvable tasks, 2 beams when the 1-beam truth window is empty). chi raises structure_ok vs base on both sides (Fisher).

tests: Wilson 95%, two-sided Fisher on pooled cells as listed in theorems_v2.report(); conclusion only if significant and stable across the 4 instances, otherwise 迹象.
exclusion: Timeouts, HTTP/URL errors, missing usage and BUDGET_STOP are excluded from denominators and rerun once; TEXT_WITHOUT_ACTION counts as a valid failure.
model: deepseek-flash, thinking high, max_tokens 65536, streaming, read timeout 300 s
budget: CAP USD 1.80 conservative uncached ledger for Y1 only; WORKERS=8; BUDGET_STOP when a worst-case 65536-token request no longer fits.
